prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Write package solution in solution.go with the function at package scope.
Required API: func IdempotencyBatchTrace(keys []string, amounts []int) ([]int, bool)
Behavior: Process aligned idempotency keys and signed amounts in arrival order. Apply only the first amount for each key and emit the cumulative total after every arrival. Reject unequal lengths or an empty key; empty input succeeds.
Visible example: keys [a,b,a,c] and amounts [5,2,99,-1] return [5,7,7,6].

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code:
package solution
func IdempotencyBatchTrace(keys []string,amounts []int)([]int,bool){if len(keys)!=len(amounts){return nil,false};seen:=map[string]bool{};out:=make([]int,len(keys));total:=0;for i,k:=range keys{if k==""{return nil,false};if !seen[k]{seen[k]=true;total+=amounts[i]};out[i]=total};return out,true}
